mission: Trace the kiosk-cash → POS Q10 → encaisser → confirmed cascade end-to-end. Verify prior phase fixes (H-SYNC-001, D2, F.10, H2-HEAL-01, C5, G2-HEAL-01/03, G.6) still hold inside the live cascade. Surface NEW findings where prior phases didn't focus (multi-cashier race, abandoned-order TTL, cash-drawer movement atomicity, receipt-print contract drift).
scope: Static cascade trace, code-only. No live boot. 13 hunts H1-H13.
method: Walk-the-cascade left-to-right exactly once: routes/api.php closure → FrontendOrderService kiosk-cash persistence → OrderCreated DispatchableAfterCommit → Echo subscribers in PosComponent/KDS → PosCounterCollectModal → /admin/pos/counter-collect/{order}/confirm closure → PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment DB::transaction → recordCashOrderMovement post-commit hook → OrderPaidAtCounter event → outbox listener → Q10 row removal cascade. Per-hunt verdict: VERIFIED CITED (cite prior heal commit/report) OR GAP (cite file:line where contract breaks).

cascade_hunts.title: Payment persistence atomicity
cascade_hunts.verdict: AMBER — atomicity boundary narrower than brief assumes
cascade_hunts.evidence: PaymentService.php:219-326 DB::transaction wraps: lockForUpdate + status flip + fiscal_sequence_no allocation + auto_prepare promotion + Transaction::firstOrCreate + AuditLogService::write. ALL roll back together if any step fails. HOWEVER three side-effects sit OUTSIDE the closure: (a) OrderPaidAtCounter::dispatch at :329, (b) OrderStatusChanged::dispatch at :343-347 conditional on auto-prepare, (c) recordCashOrderMovement at :363 conditional on CASH mode. If the Outbox/cash-movement step fails AFTER the order is PAID, the order stays PAID + audit chain extended but the secondary durable artifact is missing. Best-effort try/catch around (b) and (c) means failure is logged-and-swallowed, no rollback. Not data-corrupt for the core NF525 chain (F.10 invariants intact) but downstream sync is degraded.

cascade_hunts.title: Receipt print cascade
cascade_hunts.evidence: Button label at PosCounterCollectModal.vue:175 reads $t('button.confirm_and_print') (FR 'Confirmer et imprimer') yet NEITHER the modal's onConfirm method (:358-420) NOR PosComponent's onCounterCollectConfirmed handler (:3046-3057) triggers any window.print(), PrintReceipt component, or hardware print API call. The cashier reads the button promising print + confirm, taps it, sees a success toast, but no ticket is printed automatically. To print, the cashier must navigate to the orders tracker and click DUPLICATA manually. This breaks the implicit contract advertised on the primary confirm CTA. Either change the label to 'Confirmer' OR wire an automatic print in onCounterCollectConfirmed (e.g. open the OrderDetails ticket panel and trigger window.print()).
cascade_hunts.remediation_suggestion: Two-line fix options: (a) relabel button — change $t('button.confirm_and_print') → $t('button.confirm') in PosCounterCollectModal.vue:175 (also adjust the i18n key); OR (b) wire print — in PosComponent.vue:3046 onCounterCollectConfirmed, after the refresh awaits, dispatch a print action on the freshly-PAID order via the existing OrderDetails component path used by DUPLICATA. Owner-decision required.

cascade_hunts.title: Multi-cashier race on the SAME kiosk-cash order
cascade_hunts.evidence: _collecting guard at PosComponent.vue:3040 is a CLIENT-LOCAL per-row flag — does NOT serialize across cashier sessions. Two cashiers on the same Q10 panel can both open the modal on the same order. The backend ordering: (1) Cashier A clicks Confirm → IdempotencyKeyMiddleware acquires scoped key idempotency:v1:{branch}:{userA}:sha(key) → PaymentService DB::transaction begins → lockForUpdate; (2) Cashier B clicks Confirm → DIFFERENT scoped key (different userB → different sha bucket per H2-HEAL-01) → middleware passes through → PaymentService DB::transaction blocks on lockForUpdate; (3) Cashier A commits PAID → releases lock; (4) Cashier B acquires lock, sees payment_status === PAID at PaymentService.php:227-230, short-circuits via `$order->setRawAttributes($locked->getAttributes(), true); return;` WITHOUT raising any exception or 409 status. The modal's onConfirm catches no error and emits 'confirmed' → cashier B sees the same success toast Cashier A saw, opens the cash drawer for an order they never actually charged. Cashier B's recordCashOrderMovement call (line 363) however bails because $paid is set inside the closure-local variable; the outer if($paid) check at :328 IS satisfied for cashier B because PAID was the final state observed and the local short-circuit early-return at :228-230 does NOT set $paid to false. Re-read: line 217 declares `$paid = false;` outside the closure. The early-return at :228-230 does NOT set $paid=true; only the full happy path at :325 sets `$paid = true`. So for cashier B the outer guard `if ($paid)` is FALSE → OrderPaidAtCounter not re-dispatched, recordCashOrderMovement not re-called. GOOD — no double cash_movements, no second audit row. But cashier B's CLIENT still sees success toast at PosCounterCollectModal.vue:394-406 (driven by HTTP 2xx response — the backend returned 200 with OrderDetailsResource of the now-PAID order). Net: data integrity intact (NF525 + cash_movements + audit), but UX defect — cashier B believes they collected money, may open drawer needlessly, may double-count the till.
cascade_hunts.remediation_suggestion: Surface the no-op path: in PaymentService.php:227-230 short-circuit, do not silently return PAID — throw a typed exception (e.g. PaymentAlreadyCollectedException) caught by the route closure (api.php:813-819) and converted to a 409 with body `{'status':false,'message':'Commande déjà encaissée par un autre caissier.'}` so the modal's catch (PosCounterCollectModal.vue:415-419) toasts the conflict instead of success. Alternative: keep return-PAID but emit a flag on the response (e.g. `already_collected_by_other: true`) and let the modal pick a different toast.

cascade_hunts.title: Network drop during kiosk → POS cascade
cascade_hunts.verdict: AMBER — offline queue exists, no kiosk-cash specific retry handler
cascade_hunts.evidence: Kiosk has KioskOfflineConflictModalComponent + offline_queue i18n keys (resources/js/languages/{fr,en,de,bn,ar}.json). C7 + offline queue context is present. If network drops between FrontendOrder::create commit and Echo broadcast, the order is durable in DB (next POS poll sees it within ≤5s per H-SYNC-001 ≤5s force when readyOrders empty). If network drops BEFORE FrontendOrder::create commit, kiosk shows error and customer retries. Risk: if network drops AFTER Echo dispatch but BEFORE outbox listener writes domain_events, the Echo broadcast is lost — POS recovers via polling within 5s. Worst-case observed lag ≤5s. Not data-corrupt, performance-degraded only.

cascade_hunts.title: Customer abandons before cashier sees — TTL on PENDING_COUNTER kiosk-cash orders?
cascade_hunts.evidence: Grep on app/Console/ for PENDING_COUNTER returns ZERO matches. `pos:purge-parked-orders` (Console/Kernel.php:89) targets the pos_parked_orders TABLE (cashier-saved POS drafts via PosParkedOrderService), NOT orders.payment_status. `iter15:cleanup-test-orders` (Iter15CleanupTestOrdersCommand.php:29-37) is TEST-FIXTURE only — refuses in production at :64-67 and matches by token prefix (AUDIT-/RED-TEAM-/ZZ-TEST-/TEST-/E2E-), not by payment_status. No scheduled lane purges abandoned PENDING_COUNTER orders. Implications: (a) Q10 panel grows unbounded across days/weeks of low-attendance customer walk-aways; cashier sees pile of un-collectable phantom orders. (b) NF525 fiscal_sequence_no is NOT yet allocated for these (only allocated at confirmCounterPayment :241-243), so no chain bloat — good. (c) KDS sees PENDING_COUNTER ghost tickets with chef-prep allowed per F-002 design table — chef may prep food no one will collect. Risk amplifies with usage.
cascade_hunts.remediation_suggestion: New scheduled command e.g. `foodking:purge-abandoned-kiosk-cash --older-than-minutes=30` running every 15 min. Query: orders.where(source_surface='kiosk').where(payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER).where(created_at < now-30min). Action: transition to CANCELED via OrderStateMachine (audit-trail), DO NOT delete (NF525 retention). Add corresponding KDS purge so chef station no longer shows the ghost ticket. Owner-decision on the TTL threshold — 30 min default per typical kiosk-to-counter latency.

cascade_hunts.title: Cash drawer movement recorded — atomicity + strict mode
cascade_hunts.verdict: AMBER — kiosk counter-collect uses strict=false, silent-fail on no open session
cascade_hunts.evidence: PaymentService.php:362-364 calls recordCashOrderMovement WITHOUT passing $strict → defaults to false at :395. recordCashOrderMovement method at :392-465: when no open CashDrawerSession exists for the cashier, line 432-437 logs an Info message and silently returns. Result: order PAID + transactions row + audit row, but NO cash_movements row. End-of-day reconciliation via Z-report sees fiscal_sequence_no advance but no cash IN tracked for this order. F.10 NF525 chain remains intact (audit_logs HMAC unchanged), but the F-003 reconciliation lane shows a gap. Brief flagged this as silent-fail risk — confirmed.
cascade_hunts.remediation_suggestion: Owner-decision: either (a) keep silent-fail for V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne (single cashier rarely closes session mid-shift) and document the gap in OWNER_PHYSICAL_WALK_CHECKLIST; or (b) flip the path to strict=true so kiosk counter-collect ALSO requires an open session — would block encaissement when cashier forgot to open session, with same UX as POS direct sale post Sprint 1B. Reverting requires a UI affordance at cashier login flow.

data_integrity_attestation.nf525_chain: INTACT — audit_logs and z_reports HMAC chain extension happens inside the same DB::transaction as the PAID flip. Frozen FiscalSequenceService.php + AuditLogService.php + IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php were NOT modified (read-only audit). On rollback, the chain entry is dropped; no gap, no double-extension.
data_integrity_attestation.double_charge_prevention: INTACT — IdempotencyKeyMiddleware Phase 1 replay + DB::transaction lockForUpdate + payment_status===PAID short-circuit in PaymentService form a triple defense. Same cashier double-tap → Phase 1 cache replay. Different cashier same order → backend lockForUpdate then PAID short-circuit (H9 UX defect notwithstanding — no second money movement).
data_integrity_attestation.outbox_durability: DEGRADED — OrderPaidAtCounter outbox row creation sits OUTSIDE the PaymentService DB::transaction. Failure mode: order PAID + audit committed + cash_movement recorded, but Outbox row missing → POS Q10 + KDS recover via polling fallback within 5s. Not data-corrupt; latency-degraded only.
data_integrity_attestation.cash_movement_atomicity: DEGRADED — recordCashOrderMovement is also OUTSIDE the DB::transaction with strict=false default for the kiosk-cash path. Failure mode: order PAID + audit + Transaction row committed, but cash_movements row missing if (a) no open cash drawer session OR (b) cash service throws. End-of-day reconciliation gap. Documented as H13 finding.

race_conditions_identified.scenario: Two cashiers click Encaisser on the same Q10 row within seconds of each other
race_conditions_identified.outcome: Cashier A wins (lockForUpdate serialization). Cashier B's backend transaction sees PAID, silently short-circuits, returns 200 with OrderDetailsResource of the now-PAID order. Cashier B's modal interprets HTTP 2xx as success and toasts $t('label.cash_drawer_opened_simulation') as if money was just collected. NO duplicate cash_movements (good), but UX-misleading toast (bad).

verdict_rationale: Cascade is functionally correct for the happy path (steps 1-14 all verified). NF525 fiscal chain integrity and double-charge prevention are intact. Three discrete UX-grade defects surface: H8 button-label drift (P1), H9 multi-cashier silent-success toast (P1, NOT a data-corruption bug), H11 abandoned-order TTL gap (P2). Two atomicity boundaries (H4 outbox, H13 cash_movement) are documented degradations rather than corruption risks. No P0 findings; ship-ready for V1 Le Cayenne single-cashier use case, with owner-decision needed on H8/H9/H11 for V1.0.1 hardening.
top_5_cascade_concerns: H9 (P1) — Multi-cashier race: loser sees success toast for an encaissement they never performed; drawer-open + till-count risk.
H8 (P1) — Button labeled 'Confirmer et imprimer' but no print fires; UX contract drift requires either relabel or wire.
H11 (P2) — No scheduled cleanup for abandoned PENDING_COUNTER orders; Q10 + KDS pile grows unbounded.
H13 (P2) — recordCashOrderMovement strict=false on kiosk path: PAID without cash_movements row when no open cash session → reconciliation gap.
H4 (P2) — Outbox listener writes OUTSIDE the PaymentService DB::transaction; failure leaves order PAID with no Echo broadcast (5s polling fallback masks the symptom).
delta_t_chain_measured: STATIC AUDIT — empirical timing not measured this run. Static reasoning yields: (kiosk POST commit → OrderCreated synchronous afterCommit broadcast) typically <100ms; (Pusher/Soketi delivery to PosComponent Echo subscriber) typically 100-500ms on LAN; (POS Echo handler → loadKioskCashOrders HTTP GET → render) typically 100-300ms; (polling fallback when Echo silently fails) ≤5s per H-SYNC-001 force. Expected end-to-end ΔT(kiosk-commit → POS Q10 row visible) ≤1s normal, ≤5s degraded. Matches Wave Polish empirical claim (0-60s → ~1s).
